We got an error: functional_groups_broken expects specific names like "aliphatic hydroxyls" or "aromatic hydroxyls". Our target has an OH on a tertiary carbon in a five-membered ring, likely aliphatic hydroxyl. So we should use "aliphatic hydroxyls". Also functional_groups_formed "ketones" (plural). Use "ketones". Also bonds_order_changed maybe need specific format? Might be okay.
